title: User Registration and Role Assignment
description: Verify that new users can register with valid details, their profiles can be edited, role-based access controls are correctly assigned and enforced.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page
Fill in valid user details including unique CPF
Submit the registration form
Verify user account is created successfully and assigned default role
Attempt to login with registered credentials
Verify login is successful
Access protected page based on assigned role
Verify access is granted or denied accordingly

title: Patient Data Entry and CPF Uniqueness Validation
description: Verify that patient data entry enforces CPF uniqueness and supports secure upload of photos and documents.

steps.description: Attempt to add a new patient with a CPF that already exists in the system
Verify the system prevents duplicate CPF entry and shows appropriate error message
Add new patient with unique CPF and upload photo and documents
Verify uploads are securely processed and linked to patient record
View patient data details
Verify patient information and uploaded files are displayed correctly

title: Appointment Scheduling with Conflict Prevention
description: Verify the appointment system prevents scheduling conflicts, supports recurring appointments, status updates, and sends notifications.

steps.description: Schedule an appointment for a patient within available time slot
Verify that the appointment is created successfully
Attempt to schedule another appointment that conflicts with existing one
Verify system blocks scheduling and displays conflict warning
Create a recurring appointment series
Verify all recurring appointments are created correctly with notification triggers
Update appointment status to completed and notified
Verify the status updates are reflected and notifications sent

title: Clinical Documentation Editing and Template Usage
description: Verify clinical documentation features including rich text editing, auto-save, customizable templates, version history, and AI-generated reports.

steps.description: Open a new clinical note using a predefined template
Edit the note using the rich text editor, including inserting media
Verify content edits are saved automatically without data loss
Save and close note, then re-open to access version history
Verify different versions are available and can be restored
Request AI assistant to generate a report based on entered clinical data
Verify AI-generated report is relevant, accurate, and integrated in the note

title: AI Assistant Functionalities Validation
description: Verify AI assistant capabilities for automatic report generation, treatment protocol suggestions, risk analysis, clinical queries, and economic insights.

steps.description: Input clinical data and request AI to generate physiotherapy report
Validate AI report completeness and correctness
Request AI for recommended treatment protocols based on patient data
Check AI suggestions align with best clinical practices
Request dropout risk analysis for a selected patient
Verify AI risk analysis is returned within 10 seconds and is plausible
Submit clinical queries to AI assistant and request economic insights
Check AI provides relevant, timely responses with financial data

title: Exercise Library Browsing and Prescription
description: Verify exercise library categorization, multimedia content, personalized prescriptions, safety alerts for contraindications, and difficulty classification.

steps.description: Browse exercises filtered by specialty and difficulty
Verify correct exercises with media content are displayed
Select exercises and create a personalized prescription for a patient
Verify prescription is saved and contraindication alerts are triggered if applicable
Patient views prescribed exercises in portal
Verify exercises appear correctly with all multimedia elements

title: Patient Portal Functionality and Security
description: Verify secure login, display of personal data, access to prescribed exercises, medical history, appointment requests, and clinic communications.

steps.description: Perform login to patient portal with valid credentials
Verify successful login and loading within 2 seconds
Navigate through medical history, prescribed exercises, and appointment request forms
Verify correct and complete data visibility with no unauthorized access
Send a message to clinic via communication channel
Verify message is sent and confirmation received
Test two-factor authentication enforcement
Verify login requires 2FA code and access is denied without it

title: Reports and Dashboards Generation and Export
description: Verify generation of operational, financial, and clinical metrics dashboards with customizable reports and PDF export capability.

steps.description: Access different dashboards (Complete, Therapist, Financial)
Verify relevant metrics are displayed accurately and update dynamically
Generate customizable reports with filters and options
Verify report data correctness and formatting
Export reports to PDF format
Verify PDFs are exported correctly with proper content and layout

title: Financial Transactions and Payment Processing
description: Verify financial management functionality including payments processing via integrations (PIX, Stripe), revenue reports, and delinquency tracking.

steps.description: Process payments from patients using different payment methods (PIX, Stripe)
Verify payment succeeds, transactions recorded and receipts generated
Generate revenue and delinquency reports
Verify reports reflect accurate financial data and identify overdue payments

title: Inventory and Material Management with Alerts
description: Verify stock control, transaction history, and alert system for inventory and materials management.

steps.description: Add new inventory items and update stock quantities
Verify stock levels update correctly and transaction history logs changes
Simulate depletion of stock below alert threshold
Verify automatic alert is generated and notification is sent

title: Task Management and Notification System
description: Verify creation, prioritization, progress tracking of tasks and the proper functioning of notification and alert systems.

steps.description: Create a new task with high priority
Verify task appears in task list and relevant users are notified
Update progress on task
Verify progress is saved and notifications update accordingly
Set task deadline and wait for alert trigger
Verify alert notification is sent before deadline

title: Performance and Load Handling
description: Verify system supports page loads within 2 seconds, handles multiple simultaneous users, maintains 99.5% uptime, and processes AI queries within 10 seconds.

steps.description: Load key pages (Dashboard, Patient Portal, Clinical Notes)
Verify page load time is less than or equal to 2 seconds
Simulate multiple concurrent user sessions (e.g., 100+ users)
Verify system remains responsive and available, maintaining at least 99.5% uptime
Submit AI queries during load test
Verify AI query response times are within 10 seconds

title: Security: Data Encryption and Access Logging
description: Verify that data is encrypted in transit and at rest, two-factor authentication is enforced, and audit logs of all changes and access are maintained for LGPD compliance.

steps.description: Intercept network traffic during login and data operations
Verify data is encrypted using TLS/SSL
Verify database encryption at rest and secure storage of sensitive data
Confirm encryption mechanisms comply with security policies
Attempt login without two-factor authentication after password entry
Verify login is denied without 2FA code
Perform actions modifying sensitive patient or financial data
Verify all changes and accesses are recorded in audit logs with timestamp, user, and details

title: Interactive Body Map Functionality
description: Verify the interactive body map tool allows accurate localization of pain and injuries, saving and retrieval of mapped data.

steps.description: Open interactive body map on patient medical record
Select various body regions and mark pain or injury locations with annotations
Verify annotations are saved correctly and reflect selected body locations
Reload patient record and open body map
Verify previously saved marks persist and are displayed accurately
